notes.title: 10 New Heroes Join the Battle!
notes.content:
The war intensifies in Epic of Brave as we proudly announce the arrival of 10 new heroes, bringing the total number of heroes to 25! Whether you're a veteran or a newcomer, there's never been a better time to join the fight.

A relentless tracker, the Orc Seeker uses his heightened senses to hunt down enemies with precision. His skills focus on reducing enemy defenses and dealing devastating attacks when his prey is cornered, making him an expert in both survival and offense.

🧪 [b]Human Alchemist[/b]
A skilled master of potions, the Human Alchemist uses his vast knowledge to brew elixirs that can heal allies or harm enemies. His concoctions are powerful tools, giving him the ability to boost his team’s abilities or unleash devastating poisons on his foes.

💀 [b]Orc Phantom[/b]
The Orc Phantom is a stealthy and deadly force, capable of phasing in and out of visibility. His ability to slip past enemies and deal critical strikes from the shadows makes him an excellent assassin, capable of eliminating high-priority targets with ease.

🌿 [b]Elf Mindweaver[/b]
The Elf Mindweaver controls the minds of others with her telepathic powers. Whether manipulating enemies or boosting allies, her abilities to control the battlefield make her a versatile hero capable of turning the tide of any conflict through mental domination.

[h3]What’s New in This Update?[/h3]

With these 10 new heroes, the battlefield has become even more diverse, giving players even more ways to strategize. Whether you prefer powerful ranged attacks, stealthy maneuvers, or supportive abilities, these heroes have something for everyone.

25 Heroes Total: A rich variety of champions, each with unique skills and abilities.

Update your game now and take your team into battle with these new powerful heroes. With Epic of Brave’s ever-growing roster, the possibilities are endless. Will you rise as the ultimate champion?

We thank you for your support and look forward to seeing how you utilize these new heroes to dominate the battlefield.
